unit.unitinstructions:
GRU foundations and gated recurrent units

Build a connected understanding of numerical representations, recurrent computation, and GRU gates. The lesson includes the mathematical and recurrent-network foundations; basic algebra and the ability to read simple Python are assumed.

In the SPARC activity, work through questions, explanations, and support as they are presented. Response formats can include typed answers, one-blank completions, multiple choice, and true/false judgments. Use the format requested for the current question.

Content is adapted from Dive into Deep Learning, Section 10.2: Gated Recurrent Units and its supporting sections on linear algebra, activation functions, RNNs, and training across time. The lesson targets and questions are adapted or newly authored. D2L is licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0.
